summary: Verified the two new capture UX features and ran a regression pass. Photo capture step: initial 'Camera preview' state with Start camera + Upload buttons is correct; Start camera turns on video (label 'Camera live'); Take photo produces captured-photo-preview, label 'Photo captured', and REPLACES the capture button with a Retake button; Retake clears the preview, restarts the live camera, and allows re-capture — all data-testids match spec. Audio step IDLE state is correct: label 'Idle — press record to start', no recording-indicator, no audio-preview-wrap, .audio-visual class does NOT contain 'recording' (bars flat), only audio-capture-button ('Record') is visible and audio-stop-button does NOT exist. Clicking Record starts real MediaRecorder: label shows 'Recording... mm:ss' with running timer, recording-indicator (REC) shown, .audio-visual gets 'recording' class (bars animate), Record replaced by audio-stop-button. Stop yields audio-preview-wrap with <audio controls data-testid=audio-preview src=blob:https://...>, audio-captured-flag ('Captured'), label 'Recording ready', and audio-retake-button ('Re-record'). Re-record returns UI to Idle (preview and captured flag removed, Record visible). Regression: populate-demo-data sets sliders (depression_score=26 etc), 7-step wizard nav works, run-multimodal-assessment-button runs and navigates to /results with results-status, assessment-summary, score-source, 5 modality cards. High demo scores classified as 'Moderate Stress' (severe range acceptable per spec). Model performance /performance page: model-comparison-section renders 5 rows, 1 deployed row highlighted, baseline-note present. Responsiveness at 390px: no horizontal scroll on facial or audio steps (including with preview). Denied microphone permission could NOT be exercised in this harness — Chromium with fake media devices auto-grants regardless of clear_permissions(); code path (setError on getUserMedia reject) inspected and appears correct but was not runtime-verified.

issues: Stepper row does not wrap and overflows viewport by ~24px (scrollWidth 792 vs clientWidth 768). Last step label ('Review') is clipped and a small horizontal scrollbar appears. 390px is fine; 1440px is fine. Consider allowing .stepper to wrap or scroll horizontally within its own container at <=820px.

action_items: (optional) Fix tablet (768px) stepper horizontal overflow on /assessment — allow wrap or overflow-x on the .stepper only.

Denied-microphone path was not runtime-exercised (test harness auto-grants). Main agent may want to add a unit test or a browser-level policy override to cover it; current code appears to handle it correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: CapturePanel.js correctly stops the video stream after takePhoto and on unmount (getTracks().forEach stop) — no camera-light leak.
AudioCapture properly revokes previous blob URL (URL.revokeObjectURL) on re-record and unmount; MediaRecorder.onstop cleans the timer and MediaStream tracks — no leaks.
Waveform animation is gated only by the 'recording' class on .audio-visual, matching the requirement to stay static in idle/preview states.
audio-stop-button and audio-capture-button are mutually exclusive via ternary — spec-compliant.

Minor: audio-error is only shown for getUserMedia failure and empty-blob case; if MediaRecorder.start() throws (unsupported mimeType) it will bubble unhandled. Consider wrapping recorder.start() in try/catch.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on requested capture UX, 1 minor 768px design nit

context_for_next_testing_agent: New CapturePanel component (photo Retake + real MediaRecorder audio) is fully working with data-testids as specified. When testing in Playwright, grant camera+microphone permissions on the context; the browser runs with fake media devices so getUserMedia never rejects — denied-permission branch cannot be verified through the browser harness. Step 2 is reachable via [data-testid='assessment-step-2-button'] (step name text is hidden at mobile widths). Performance page route is /performance (not /model-performance). Known minor UI issue: on /assessment at 768px the 7-step stepper overflows ~24px horizontally.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. The 768px tablet stepper overflow is caused by .stepper being a non-wrapping flex row with 7 items — total intrinsic width exceeds available 768-sidebar space. Fix: add flex-wrap:wrap or overflow-x:auto to .stepper under a @media (max-width: 900px) rule in App.css.
